body:
PR #2934 (BUG-2223) rework pushed: new head cb0c2f1493215b9ba92fc274dd5481d855b92d02 (merged origin/main first, no force).
Round-1 findings addressed:
1. Hints never ping-pong: every scope-conflict refusal (DormantDirty/StaleDirty/ReclaimableClean) offers --resume only when lease_adoption_refusal(conflict) is None, i.e. --resume adopts that very lease. A dirty orphan with no owner pid now gets the refusal reason + `aida session end <id> --force`.
2. Multiplicity/authority (binding 1): the sweep skips only the adopted id (leases::next_scope_conflict) and still releases/refuses every other lease; force_claim is no longer forced. session_start_with_receipt gains adopt_orphan, which permits only the path re-entry (+ the In Progress status gate the orphan holds); the cross-clone claim ledger and BUG-637 live-claim gates are untouched, and another session's tree on the scope refuses adoption instead of being re-entered.
3. Tests added: hint/--resume agreement with and without owner pid; live older lease on adopted scope refuses (both leases + work intact); adopting a non-orphan path refuses.
Gate: targeted cargo test (orphan_reentry_tests + queue_work_resume, 27 pass), make check-ci-fast green (35 gates). Ready for an independent round-2 reviewer.
